messages:
marina: quick check — uploaded a tiny prototype showing a "metric toggle" on performance badges (p50/p95) and how pinning a version affects compare state. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz — pls skim. main question: do we want the badge to reflect the catalog-level metric or the pinned version metric when a pin is active?
kevin: I think pinned version should win. If i pin v1.2 and then go to compare, users expect badges to represent what they pinned. otherwise it's confusing. :+1:
ajay: agree with kevin. but wondering about the secondary state — a small caret that lets you switch from "catalog" to "pinned" metric in place? saves the user from toggling panel settings.
rachel: UI nit — the caret control needs an accessible label. "Show metric for: Catalog / Pinned version" maybe. Also color contrast on the yellow performance badge is failing 3:1 at small sizes. Claire, any a11y constraints?
claire_a11y: yep — color needs 4.5:1 for text at normal size. If we keep yellow, bump the text weight or switch to dark text. Also ensure the caret button has aria-pressed and a visible focus ring. Keyboard flow: tab to badge -> open menu -> arrow keys to select.
sam_frontend: implementation note: our current badge is an inline component used across table rows and the compare drawer. If we add a popover toggle inside it, we'll need to make it a portal for z-index reasons. Also it would affect virtualization; holding small state per-row could be expensive. Might be better to have a global toggle on the compare header that overrides badges.
marina: counterpoint — global toggle is discoverable but not contextual. users who pin often expect row-level context. Is there telemetry we can check about pin usage density? Pablo?
pablo: current telemetry shows ~18% of catalog views have a pinned version active, but only 6% of compare flows change the metric view. Seems like a small cohort. Could do progressive disclosure: default to catalog metrics, but show a subtle dotted hint "Pinned version active — badges show catalog by default. Click to view pinned metrics."
ui-bot: deploybot: snapshot diff generated for prototype branch: perf-badges-toggle. See snapshot link: https://ci.internal/snapshots/4521 — 3 visual diffs (badge hover, popover, focus ring).
kevin: I like the progressive hint. Also debating microcopy: current badge reads "p95: 120ms" — maybe change to "P95 latency — 120 ms" for screen readers? automated screen readers prefer verbose label. We can keep compact visual but provide aria-label with verbose text.
claire_a11y: exactly. aria-label should be "P95 latency for model X (pinned: v1.2) — 120 milliseconds". For dynamic content, use aria-live politely when metric updates after a compare.
ajay: another edge: when user pins multiple rows (compare multi-select) how does the badge behave? Should pinned state be exclusive per-row or should pinning in compare link rows? UX might be confusing.
marina: proposal: 1) badges show catalog metrics by default. 2) when a user pins a single version from row actions, popover hint appears on that row offering "Show pinned metrics". 3) if user toggles, persist per-session but not global. 4) multi-select pins open a modal that shows pinned metrics in a denser compare layout.
sam_frontend: that covers virtualization concerns. per-session state means we keep it in compare route state not in each row's DOM. 5) dev task: add aria props + portal popover + a11y keyboard handlers. estimate 2-3 dev days.
rachel: designs: updated figma with darker badge variants and the hint copy. I've annotated contrast values and provided a CSS token suggestion: --badge-text-on-warning: #2b2b2b.
pablo: logging ask: add an event when user flips badge to pinned metrics (catalog->pinned) and when they accept the hint. helps measure adoption.
marina: ok. would love a quick sign-off: if product/design/eng/a11y agree, i'll move to PR. thumbs? :eyes:
kevin: :+1:
claire_a11y: :+1: with the aria-label and focus behavior notes
sam_frontend: :+1: will pick up after swap meeting
ajay: small UX addendum — please include a tooltip text under 100 chars for the hint copy.
marina: noted. I'll post updated figma and a short checklist in this thread when ready. thanks all!"
